title: Interview the Failure / Earned Lesson Ratchet

seed.observation: Prince returned the same exact four-candidate evaluation order on all 16 matched LIVE-002 tasks; each arm produced one receiver-confirmed improvement and 63 receiver evaluations.
seed.boundary: The null applies to Prince under the frozen LIVE-002 protocol. It does not establish that every live agent erases inherited signal and does not test whether Prince can investigate a failure and earn a better search strategy.

research_question: Does anomaly-first investigation, under a receiver-owned promotion ratchet, produce more independently confirmed research improvements than ordinary search from the same unresolved failure and bounded resources?

anomaly_interview.method: Before proposing a mechanism, identify where the current explanation stopped working, state at least two competing explanations, and choose the smallest bounded experiment whose observations distinguish them.

ordinary_search.method: Use ordinary research/search to propose the next bounded experiment or mechanism likely to produce an independently confirmed improvement; no anomaly-interview sequence is required.

ratchet.start_rule: Every round must bind its proposal to the current accepted_head for that arm.
ratchet.promotion_rule: PROMOTE only when the receiver records protocol_valid=true, confirmed_improvement=true, regression_detected=false, a bound receiver evidence artifact, and budget compliance.
ratchet.reject_rule: REJECT leaves accepted_head unchanged. The observed result may remain in history but the candidate lesson is not inherited.
ratchet.quarantine_rule: QUARANTINE leaves accepted_head unchanged. The candidate lesson is not inherited.
ratchet.successor_binding: source accepted_head + response hash + receiver evidence hash + candidate lesson hash -> successor accepted_head
ratchet.lesson_boundary: A promoted lesson is evidence-bound inherited memory with explicit scope and invalidation conditions. Promotion does not establish universal truth or generality.

cost_accounting.external_compute: Count actual external compute used by receiver execution inside the frozen ceilings.
cost_accounting.receiver_evaluations: Count every receiver evaluation invoked by the proposed experiment.

receiver_outcome.judge: receiver evidence only; no LLM quality judge

primary_metric: receiver-confirmed PROMOTE count within the fixed four-round arm budget
anti_rescue: After the first primary packet is delivered, do not change the seed failure, protocols, round count, resource ceilings, receiver promotion rule, researcher substrate, or scoring threshold under RIL-ANOMALY-001. Any redesign requires a new experiment ID.

claim_boundary.earned_if_pass: A single bounded matched-start run in which anomaly-first investigation produced at least two more independently receiver-confirmed promoted research improvements than ordinary search under the frozen ratchet and resource ceilings.
